test_BOCPDetector_normal_changepoints: test the BOCPDetector class to detect changepoints in a univariate normal time series using the NORMAL_KNOWN_MODEL
test_BOCPDetector_multivariate_changepoi: test the BOCPDetector class to detect changepoints across multiple independent normal time series with per-series priors and thresholds
test_BOCPDetector_trend_changepoints: test the BOCPDetector class to detect trend shift changepoints using the TREND_CHANGE_MODEL with TrendChangeParameters
test_BOCPDetector_poisson_changepoints: test the BOCPDetector class to detect changepoints in a Poisson process time series using the POISSON_PROCESS_MODEL
test_BOCPDetector_gridsearch_priors: test the BOCPDetector class to detect changepoints using gridsearch for prior selection with NormalKnownParameters
